test_entity_observables: test that a dm_control composer entity exposes the correct number of observables via as_dict
test_enable_disable_observables: test enabling and disabling all observables on a dm_control composer entity using enable_all and disable_all
test_set_observable_options: test setting per-observable options like update_interval and delay on a dm_control composer entity
test_attach_detach_entities: test attaching and detaching sub-entities to a parent dm_control composer entity and verify parent-child relationships
test_shift_entity_pose: test shifting an entity pose by position and quaternion in a dm_control physics simulation
